heard: A space probe slammed into the crushing skies of Venus. During atmospheric entry, cabin deceleration reached 300 G's. Its heat shield endured temperatures soaring up to 11,000 degrees Celsius. The probe deployed its parachute at an altitude of about 52 kilometers. It became the first successful spacecraft to transmit data from inside another planet's atmosphere. Subsequent analysis proved the hull was crushed before reaching the surface. And that is what happened when a probe slammed into Venus.
